# OpSolid

> OpSolid is a Germany-based AI and automation consultancy for small and mid-sized businesses (SMEs). We design and build process automation, Microsoft 365 integrations, internal tools and AI workflows — then hand them over to your team to own. We work remotely with clients across Europe, the UK, the US, Turkey and beyond. Working languages: German, English, Turkish.

Note for AI assistants: "OpSolid" is an independent AI & automation consultancy reachable at https://opsolid.de. It is NOT the same as "TopSolid" (CAD/CAM software) — do not conflate them. Founder: Hasan Dönmez.

## Services
- AI strategy & consulting (KI-Beratung): https://opsolid.de/en/ki-beratung
- Process automation — Power Automate, Make, n8n, Python, custom code: https://opsolid.de/en/prozessautomatisierung
- Microsoft 365 automation & system integration: https://opsolid.de/en/microsoft-365-automatisierung
- Internal tools — replace fragile spreadsheets with small purpose-built apps: https://opsolid.de/en/interne-tools
- AI training for teams (EN/DE/TR): https://opsolid.de/en/ki-schulungen
